title: Houthis Strike Saudi VLCC Amzan with Ballistic Missile Off Yanbu
detail: Yemen's Houthi movement claimed a ballistic missile strike on the Bahri-owned VLCC Amzan (IMO 9693745) roughly 63 nautical miles west of the Red Sea port of Yanbu, sparking a fire on the main deck. Bahri and UKMTO confirmed all crew were safe with no injuries or environmental impact reported. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree called it a 'precise and direct hit,' part of the group's 'siege for siege' maritime campaign against Saudi-linked shipping launched in mid-July. Yanbu, roughly 600 miles from Houthi territory, is a key alternative export outlet for Saudi crude via the East-West Pipeline as the Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed.

title: France and Saudi Arabia Issue Joint Statement Welcoming Hamas Disarmament Deal, Urging Iran Diplomacy
detail: Meeting at the Elysee Palace, President Macron and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman issued a joint statement welcoming the newly announced agreement on Hamas's disarmament and calling for its implementation, while urging a 'sustainable ceasefire' and unhindered humanitarian access in Gaza. On Iran, the two leaders reaffirmed commitment to a diplomatic solution over Tehran's nuclear program and called on Iran to resume full cooperation with the IAEA. They also condemned attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and demanded navigation be restored to its pre-February 28, 2026 status, free of tolls or restrictions, in line with international law.
